        panels = []
        bindings = {}
        if old["triplet"]:
            methods = ["V172-raw"] if old["panels"][1]["label"] == "V171-raw" else ["V172-EMA"]
            selections = [old["panels"][0], *methods, old["panels"][-1]]
        else:
            mapping = {p["label"]: p for p in old["panels"]}
            selections = [
                mapping["Noisy Malvar"],
                mapping["V143 parent"],
                mapping["V169 EMA"],
                mapping["V171-EMA"],
                "V172-raw",
                "V172-EMA",
            ]
            selections += [
                p
                for p in old["panels"]
                if p["label"].startswith("V161")
                or p["label"]
                in [
                    "Periodic detail",
                    "Exact constructed GT",
                    "ISO100 AHD, not GT",
                    "ISO6400 JPEG native",
                    "ISO100 JPEG, not GT",
                ]
            ]
        for selection in selections:
            if isinstance(selection, str):
                binding = values[selection]

                value = np.load(binding["path"])

                actual = pixels(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                    actual, independent_display(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                )
                assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                channels += actual.size
                bindings[selection] = binding
                panels.append((selection, actual))
            else:
                x, y, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                assert w == h == 160
                panels.append((selection["label"], source[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
                copied_channels += w * h * 3
        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(panels), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"{case['id']} | V172 local noise matching,contrast{old['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="black",
        )
        records = []
        for j, (label, value) in enumerate(panels):
            x = 8 + 168 * j
            draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
            board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
            records.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})
        path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
        board.save(path)
        image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
        for record, (_, value) in zip(records, panels, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = record["xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], value)
        figures.append(
            {
                "case": case,

                "anchor": old["anchor"],
                "contrast": old["contrast"],
                "exposure": old["exposure"],

                "predictions": bindings,
                "source_figure": old["image"],
                "no_resize": True,
                "triplet": old["triplet"],
            }
        )
    assert len(figures) == 60 and sum(i["triplet"] for i in figures) == 12
    sheets = []

        width = max(Image.open(i["image"]["path"]).width for i in group)

        for j, item in enumerate(group):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, j * 212))
        path = out / f"sheet-{n:02d}.png"
        sheet.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {"indices": list(range(n * 4, n * 4 + 4)), "image": ref(path), "no_resize": True}
        )
    save(
        ROOT / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(ROOT / "scores-v1.json"),
            "images": figures,

            "native_figures": 60,

            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered60 native figures/12triplets;new/copied channels", channels, copied_channels)

def make_module(plan, counts, *, state=None):
    from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail

    m = LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan["module_config"])
    m.load_frozen_component(plan["frozen_component"]["export"]["path"])
    if state is not None:
        m.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
    m.cuda()
    for name, child in [("wrapper", m), ("frozen", m.frozen), ("network", m.network)]:
        child.register_forward_hook(
            lambda *args, name=name: counts.__setitem__(name, counts[name] + 1)
        )
    for child in m.network.modules():
        if type(child).__name__ == "NonlocalBlock":
            child.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("sampler", counts["sampler"] + 1)
            )
    return m


def tree_equal(a, b):
    import torch

    if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(b, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(a.cpu(), b.cpu())
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(tree_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(a) is type(b)
            and len(a) == len(b)
            and all(tree_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True))
        )
    return a == b

def rng():

def errors(value, target, roi):
    x, y, w, h = roi

    return {"full_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(full**2))*65535), "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((crop-dc)**2))*65535), "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2))*65535)}

def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import band

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import linear_rgb

    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y : y + h, x : x + w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    error = a - b
    dc = error.mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
    predicted, _ = band(linear_rgb(a, arrays))
    truth, _ = band(linear_rgb(b, arrays))
    energy = float(np.sum(truth * truth))
    if energy <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Photo diagnostic needs nonzero target detail")
    gain = float(np.sum(predicted * truth) / energy)
    return {
        "full_error_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.mean((value.astype(np.float64) - target) ** 2)) * 65535
        ),
        "crop_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain": gain,
        "crop_relative_band_error": float(np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - truth) ** 2) / energy)),
        "crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - gain * truth) ** 2) / (100 * 256)) * 65535
        ),
    }

    for observation in plan["observations"]:
        assert ref(observation["arrays"]["path"]) == observation["arrays"]
        with np.load(observation["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as data:
            arrays = {k: data[k] for k in data.files}
        values = {}
        for label, bindings in predictions.items():
            binding = bindings[observation["id"]]
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            values[label] = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "id": observation["id"],
                    "source_id": observation["source"]["id"],
                    "cohort": observation["cohort"],
                    "variant": observation["variant"]["name"],
                    "pattern": observation["pattern"],
                    "method": label,
                    "prediction": binding,
                    **photo_metrics(
                        values[label], arrays["target"], arrays, observation["ROI_xywh"]
                    ),
                }
            )
        if observation["pattern"] != "RGGB":
            continue
        all_values = {"Noisy": noisy_malvar(arrays), **values, "Constructed GT": arrays["target"]}
        roi = observation["ROI_xywh"]
        x, y, w, h = roi
        anchor = (
            arrays["target"][..., y : y + h, x : x + w]
            .astype(np.float64)
            .mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
        )

        def emit(
            labels,
            contrast,
            suffix,
            observation=observation,
            all_values=all_values,
            anchor=anchor,
            arrays=arrays,
            roi=roi,
        ):
            canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(labels), 192), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
            panels = []
            for i, label in enumerate(labels):
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                x0 = 8 + 168 * i
                canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), (x0, 24))
                draw.text((x0, 5), label, font=font, fill="black")
                panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x0, 24, 160, 160]})
            target = out / (observation["id"] + "-" + suffix + ".png")
            canvas.save(target)
            reread = np.asarray(Image.open(target))
            for panel in panels:
                label = panel["label"]
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                x0, y0, w0, h0 = panel["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y0 : y0 + h0, x0 : x0 + w0], cell)
            images.append(
                {
                    "image": ref(target),
                    "observation": observation,
                    "panels": panels,
                    "checkpoint_hashes": {k: v["sha256"] for k, v in checkpoints.items()},
                    "shared_display_contrast": contrast,
                    "shared_camera_RGB_anchor": anchor.ravel().tolist(),
                    "display_exposure": observation["display_exposure"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                }
            )

        emit(list(all_values), 1, "comparison")
        if observation["variant"]["name"] == "photo-faint":
            emit(list(all_values), 8, "contrast8-comparison")
        if observation["cohort"] == "organic384" and observation["source"]["id"] in (
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][0]["id"],
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][1]["id"],
        ):
            for method in ("V144", "V145"):
                emit(["Noisy", method, "Constructed GT"], 1, method + "-triplet")
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[row["cohort"], row["variant"], row["method"]].append(row)
    keys = [k for k, v in rows[0].items() if isinstance(v, float)]
    summary = [
        {
            "cohort": k[0],
            "variant": k[1],
            "method": k[2],
            "cases": len(v),
            "independent_source_images": len({r["source_id"] for r in v}),
            **{metric: float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in v])) for metric in keys},
        }
        for k, v in groups.items()
    ]
    save(
        out / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-photographic-supplement-report-awaiting-independent-audit-and-viewing",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "images": images,
            "actual_new_root_and_encoder_calls": 320,
            "new_noise_observations": 64,
            "metric_definition": "Camera-RGB error and DC/spatial decomposition; native160 linear-sRGB "
            "luma DCT16 annulus1/8<=frequency<1/3, no content selection. Ideal gain1; gain requires "
            "error/residual checks. Constructed targets are not exact physical scene GT. Per-CFA "
            "cases share16 source images; do not treat128 cases as128 independent photos.",
        },
    )
    print(out / "result-v1.json")
